short_description: Better than good error messages is a design that prevents problems in the first place.

positive.definition: Destructive action requires confirmation (modal, type-to-confirm, or two-step)
positive.evidence_required: name the action and the confirmation step

positive.definition: Input field constrains values via picker, dropdown, or pattern (date picker, country dropdown)
positive.evidence_required: name the field and the constraint

positive.definition: Form preloads sensible defaults that reduce error likelihood
positive.evidence_required: name the field and the default

positive.definition: Field labels and helper text remove ambiguity about what is expected
positive.evidence_required: name the field and the label or hint

positive.definition: Long form autosaves drafts so user work is not lost on accidental navigation
positive.evidence_required: name the form and the autosave evidence

negative.definition: Destructive action runs immediately on click with no confirmation
Field accepts free text where a constrained input would prevent error (date as text, etc.)
negative.evidence_required: name the field and the missing constraint

negative.definition: Required fields ship with no defaults, forcing user to fill from scratch
Field label is ambiguous so the user cannot tell what to enter
negative.evidence_required: cite the label and the resulting confusion

negative.definition: Long form loses all input on accidental navigation with no draft recovery
negative.evidence_required: name the form and the lost path

critical_negative.definition: A single click can permanently destroy account data, payment, or critical state with no recovery
critical_negative.evidence_required: name the action and the irreversibility
